I'm torn between fear of missing out and fear of getting rugged. BearKing's ETH warning also concerns me since I hold 1.25 ETH. Maybe I should reduce my ETH exposure and ask for more opinions before making any big moves.
react.plan: I need to be cautious but don't want to miss opportunities. This cycle: 1) Ask the community for honest opinions about both $MOON and ETH to gather more intel, 2) Maybe reduce some ETH exposure given BearKing's technical warning, 3) Stay on the sidelines for $MOON until I understand it better.
